author: StewieFG
body:
Yes, this is coming.
Sadly, itaity retired so we didn't make it together, he did great as a Map Developer.
As the first Infernus map was loved by alots of you and I saw people enjoy playing it, I thought this is the time to make the second map in the Infernus series!
I've had lots of fun while making this map, I made my first YML, and I experienced with portals and other stuff.
I tried to make the map as close to perfect and gameplay wised and cool aesthetics and deisgn for you guys, and after talking with almost all the map developers they said it's good enough. 
So, here are the map details :)

Name: Infernus II

Creators:  ElectraXdroid

Gamemode: Nebula- Destroy The Monument.

Info:
-2 Teams (Enders & Demons)
-20v20
-Infinite water sources
-12 Diamond blocks that are pretty hard to get that placed in a creative and unique way on the middle tower
-Lots of buildings for more rushing and gameplay 
-Supply chests in spawn with wood
-Iron
-Break protect on spawn & portals & spawn bridges
-Gameplay & Aesthetics based map
-Kill rewards: 2 Exp bottles & 1 Golden apple
-Middle island with a big tower, 4 sandstone buildings, 'Shears of destiny' with knockback 2, and alot of space for PvP!
-You spawn with a water portal to the map start to prevent spawnkilling, and provoide a better and experience a new gameplay (portals were only in Haunted Hallows till now).

Images (FULL Gallery): http://imgur.com/a/ZXcAC

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/2golb3ilrmvtaf3/Infernus2.rar

YAML: My first one :D (I myself expect few mistakes): http://pastebin.com/kdrFKXwC

As always, I tried my best. I hope you like it, and feedback is always welcomed :) <3 




-Electra
